question: Leprosy is caused by a bacterium called:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mycobacterium leprae**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Leprosy** is a contagious disease that causes disfiguring skin sores and nerve damage in the arms, legs, and other regions of the body.
 
• It is caused by Mycobacterium leprae, a slow-growing pathogen (M. leprae).
